question: What is the upper limit and subdivision of the three-storeyed ābhāsa type?
premises: The range extends up to fifteen or sixteen units.
The type is the three-storeyed ābhāsa.
It is divided into ten forms.
inference: The three-storeyed ābhāsa type extends up to fifteen or sixteen and is tenfold.
uncertainties: The symbolic values of tithi and kalā are interpreted conventionally.
plain_english: The three-storeyed ābhāsa, extending up to fifteen or sixteen, is divided into ten forms.
